name: Overseer.exe
tagline: A Roblox gatekeeper game: spot disguised impostors and remove anyone asking for codes or private chats.
problem: Safety education for young players relies on static warnings and quizzes.
solution: Players inspect visitors at a gate, then watch LLM-generated NPC conversations for unsafe requests such as secret codes or moving off-platform; protected NPCs return as allies in a boss fight.
demo_moment: Team-described: catch an impostor at the gate and eject a player asking to chat elsewhere.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Disguises safety lessons as survival decisions.

lessons: Make recognising manipulation the way to win, not a quiz afterwards.
